reason: Question asks for 5 or more customers but HAVING uses > 5, so countries with exactly 5 customers are dropped.
Conditional sums for 2025 and 2024 give the percent change (new-old)/old, rounded to 2 digits with float division; correct.
Joining Track multiplies rows, so COUNT(*) counts tracks rather than albums (needs COUNT(DISTINCT AlbumId)); albums without tracks are also lost.
Simple count of customers with Country = 'Brazil'.
'từ 13.86 trở lên' means >= 13.86, but the query uses > so invoices of exactly 13.86 are excluded.
Correct join to MediaType, filter by name, AVG of Track.UnitPrice.
COUNT(DISTINCT GenreId) over Track ignoring NULLs counts genres that have at least one track.
Selects BirthDate instead of HireDate, so it returns the wrong column for 'ngày vào làm'.
Correct join Album-Artist filtered by Name 'AC/DC', returns album titles.
ORDER BY Milliseconds ASC returns the 10 shortest tracks, but the question wants the longest first (DESC).
